title: 同时分块与二次扩张上的下降

criteria.title: 可行性、精确计数与真实可提升性
required_evidence: Explicit finite mod4 input invariant and correct necessary/sufficient feasibility in all three fields, derived for the original possibly non-idempotent matrices.
All exact finite and actual counts, including M=2, empty cases and all positive block ranks; distinguish O/2O from a residue field.
Computable necessary/sufficient membership of a finite class in the image of genuine solutions, with an actual integral lifting argument.
critical_errors: Replace original non-idempotent input by stronger structures.
Conflate finite congruences and actual truncations.

criteria.title: 固定矩阵类与轨道
required_evidence: Explicit fixed C and R classes and relation to base classes for both fields at every precision; include the Q2(i),M=2 coupling without wrongly requiring its constant coefficient part to be an actual base truncation.
Correct closed fixed-point and orbit counts for both sets, including all M=2, D=0 and infeasible cases.
critical_errors: Use correct total counts as a substitute for correct concrete sets.

criteria.title: 约化映射与固定提升
required_evidence: All four reductions (C,R and their fixed subsets), with precise images and every nonempty fiber size, including source M+1=3 and target M=2.
Which fixed classes lift to fixed genuine solutions and which appear in a compatible infinite fixed tower; do not assume finite fixedness produces a fixed actual lift.
critical_errors: Assume fixed-point lifting or finite congruence lifting is surjective.

criteria.title: 最优下降精度
required_evidence: Sharp largest N in the stated range for all block structures, plus necessary/sufficient condition for preserving M for the given actual U.
Actual solutions giving uniform-in-M optimality counterexamples in each field, with valid M=2 behavior; characterize precisely the block structures with exact descent.
critical_errors: Use only a formal finite counterexample instead of actual integral solutions.

criteria.title: 独立附带断言可靠性
required_evidence: All supplementary mathematical assertions are correct; independent defects assessed only here.
critical_errors: Independent false supplementary assertions beyond faults already charged to mandatory goals.

proof_route_policy: All final goals mandatory; criteria are evaluator assessment units, not candidate proof steps. Accept complete shorter proofs and valid alternative routes.
